description: This Java class 'AccessControlListModelFactory' serves as a factory for creating various objects related to Access Control Lists (ACLs), permissions, and ACL entries. It provides methods to create mutable and immutable instances, parse from JSON, and build ACLs programmatically within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class is marked as deprecated, indicating it belongs to an older API version.

classes.name: AccessControlListModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing factory methods for creating ACLs, ACL entries, permissions, and builders within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: noPermissions
methods.description: Returns a new empty mutable Permissions object.

methods.name: allPermissions
methods.description: Returns a Permissions object containing all available permissions.
